serverInstructions: Operate only on the explicitly named Dharma organization. Sensitive reads and every mutation require user confirmation.

source.description: Tool registrations of the hosted Dharma HQ MCP route at its production revision, in registration order (the order tools/list returns).

liveCrossCheck.method: Tool names listed by https://mcp.dharma-ai.io/mcp to an authenticated MCP client; descriptions spot-checked for fabric_rollout_rollback, fabric_remediation_merge_pr and fabric_list_trajectories.

tools.name: fabric_control_read_org_status
tools.title: Read control-agent organization status
tools.description: Reads bounded activation, provisioning and capability status in the named organization. No model turn, mutation or provider call.

tools.name: fabric_control_read_agents
tools.title: Read control-agent endpoint summary
tools.description: Reads bounded logical agent and endpoint summaries in the named organization, without credentials. No model turn or mutation.

tools.name: fabric_control_read_trajectories
tools.title: Read control-agent trajectory summary
tools.description: Reads bounded reduced trajectory records in the named organization. Does not expand raw evidence or start a model turn.

tools.name: fabric_control_read_failures
tools.title: Read control-agent failure summary
tools.description: Reads bounded failure families and their existing evidence lineage in the named organization. No model turn or mutation.

tools.name: fabric_control_read_remediations
tools.title: Read control-agent remediation summary
tools.description: Reads bounded remediation candidates, gates, bundles and rollout status in the named organization. Does not approve, release or run a model.

tools.name: fabric_control_read_usage
tools.title: Read control-agent usage summary
tools.description: Reads bounded usage, credit allocation and settlement records in the named organization. Does not grant credits or initiate billed work.

tools.name: fabric_control_read_runs
tools.title: Read control-agent runtime runs
tools.description: Reads bounded managed and BYOK run status in the named organization without credentials. Does not start or cancel runs.

tools.name: fabric_control_read_evaluations
tools.title: Read control-agent evaluation summary
tools.description: Reads bounded campaign, task and authoritative result summaries in the named organization. Does not start evaluations or expose held-out scorer truth.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_analysis
tools.title: Execute one proposed analysis window
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately executes the exact pending billed analysis proposal, including its stored bounded scope or retry identity, after confirmation and hash validation. Existing analysis, budget, scope and idempotency checks remain; this is execution, not merely recording approval.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_managed_run
tools.title: Execute one proposed environment run
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately starts the exact pending billed managed or customer-authorized BYOK run after confirmation. work must match its agent, prompt, runtime and estimated-credit reservation; argumentsHash binds all stored metadata and attachments too. Existing provider, authorization, preauthorization and settlement gates remain. Identical retries do not authorize another run.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_evaluation_campaign
tools.title: Execute one proposed evaluation campaign
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately creates and starts the exact pending billed evaluation campaign after confirmation. work must match its name, arms and task count; argumentsHash binds every stored task and setting. Existing per-trajectory credit preauthorization, provider and campaign gates remain. This does not admit held-out truth or override promotion authority.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_task
tools.title: Execute one proposed local task dispatch
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately dispatches the exact pending signed local-task proposal after confirmation and argument-hash validation. Existing endpoint, workspace, command, policy, budget and lease checks remain; no arbitrary shell or new access.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_a2a
tools.title: Execute one proposed agent handoff
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately dispatches the exact pending bounded A2A proposal after confirmation and argument-hash validation. May start work under existing endpoint authority and budgets; does not widen recipient, workspace or source policy.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_remediation_approval
tools.title: Execute one proposed remediation approval
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately records the exact pending remediation approval after confirmation and argument-hash validation. A stored establishAutoUpdatePolicy=true also establishes persistent organization-agent update authority across supported providers. Inspect stored arguments first; existing evidence and release gates remain. Does not itself merge or release.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_rollout_start
tools.title: Execute one proposed rollout start
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately starts the exact pending signed canary rollout after confirmation and argument-hash validation. Cannot select expansion or rollback; existing risk, approval, tenant and rollout checks remain.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_rollout_expand
tools.title: Execute one proposed rollout expansion
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately expands the exact pending signed rollout after confirmation and argument-hash validation. The historical internal rollout.start catalog also carries expansion proposals; this distinct public tool accepts only that stored expansion. Existing transition, health and risk checks remain.

tools.name: fabric_control_execute_rollout_rollback
tools.title: Execute one proposed rollout rollback
tools.description: Organization admin only. Immediately rolls back the exact pending signed rollout after confirmation and argument-hash validation. Cannot select start or expansion; existing ancestor, approval and tenant checks remain.

tools.name: fabric_control_reject_proposal
tools.title: Reject one pending control-agent proposal
tools.description: Organization admin only. Rejects the exact pending proposal after confirmation; never executes its stored operation. Existing tenant, state and idempotency checks remain.

tools.name: fabric_rollout_start
tools.title: Start one signed skill rollout
tools.description: Starts one signed bundle canary rollout after explicit organization confirmation. The server fixes start; current tenant, risk, approval and idempotency gates remain.

tools.name: fabric_rollout_expand
tools.title: Expand one signed skill rollout
tools.description: Expands one existing signed bundle rollout after explicit organization confirmation. The server fixes expand; current transition, tenant, risk, health and idempotency gates remain.

tools.name: fabric_rollout_rollback
tools.title: Roll back one signed skill rollout
tools.description: Rolls back one existing signed bundle rollout after explicit organization confirmation. The server fixes rollback; current tenant, ancestor, risk and idempotency gates remain. Does not erase signed history.

tools.name: fabric_list_learning_policies
tools.title: List automatic learning policies
tools.description: Reads organization-scoped policy metadata. Listing does not enroll an endpoint or authorize spending.

tools.name: fabric_get_learning_policy
tools.title: Read automatic learning progress
tools.description: Returns configuration, evidence coverage, costs, candidate and rollout progress without exposing raw trajectories.

tools.name: fabric_list_learning_windows
tools.title: Read frozen learning windows
tools.description: Lists retained window membership and status with the same pagination and evaluation-read authorization as the HTTP API.

tools.name: fabric_create_learning_policy
tools.title: Configure automatic learning for an endpoint
tools.description: Organization-admin only. Requires explicit confirmation, a complete consent-bound configuration and spending caps. Enabling permits asynchronous learning and gated rollout; it never overrides a release gate.

tools.name: fabric_update_learning_policy
tools.title: Pause, resume or revise an automatic learning policy
tools.description: Organization-admin only. Requires confirmation, expectedRevision and the complete configuration. Use a new idempotency key per revision and reuse that key only for identical retries. Cannot remove an immutable study scope or bypass calibration, budget or promotion gates.

tools.name: fabric_submit_calibration_references
tools.title: Submit independent grader calibration references
tools.description: Organization-admin only with confirmation. Submit a separately signed exact 100-request reference set through the canonical API. Preserves signed UTF-8 bytes, tenant/endpoint/contract/consent binding and learning/held-out isolation. Does not admit a signer, change policy caps, start paid work or activate a skill/grader. Signature authenticates an admitted authority, not label correctness.

tools.name: fabric_get_identity
tools.title: Inspect the authenticated Agent Fabric identity
tools.description: Returns the current Clerk identity and only its membership-binding state for the requested organization.

tools.name: fabric_list_devices
tools.title: List enrolled Agent Fabric devices
tools.description: Lists organization devices without exposing local paths or credentials.

tools.name: fabric_list_agents
tools.title: List logical agents and endpoint bindings
tools.description: Lists organization agent identities and their local, managed, or BYOK endpoint bindings.

tools.name: fabric_list_repository_agents
tools.title: List repository agents
tools.description: Lists one logical agent per connected source repository, its permanent control branch, and lifecycle state.

tools.name: fabric_get_instructions
tools.title: Get organization Agent Fabric instructions
tools.description: Returns credential-free setup commands, control-repository details, connected repository agents, and role boundaries.

tools.name: fabric_create_agent
tools.title: Create a logical Agent Fabric agent
tools.description: Creates one organization-scoped logical agent identity without granting an execution endpoint.

tools.name: fabric_bind_local_endpoint
tools.title: Bind an enrolled local provider endpoint
tools.description: Binds one task-capable enrolled workspace/provider to an existing logical agent. It does not expose local paths or credentials.

tools.name: fabric_bind_runtime_endpoint
tools.title: Bind a managed ADK or GCP Vertex BYOK endpoint
tools.description: Binds an active deployed runtime to a repository-derived logical agent after explicit confirmation. Runtime identities and credentials remain server-side.

tools.name: fabric_list_workspaces
tools.title: List Agent Fabric workspaces
tools.description: Lists repository-qualified workspaces and provider capabilities without local paths.

tools.name: fabric_list_trajectories
tools.title: List bounded trajectory capsules
tools.description: Lists redacted trajectory summaries and provenance. It does not expand full evidence.

tools.name: fabric_get_trajectory_evidence
tools.title: Expand one trajectory evidence record
tools.description: Returns bounded revision capsules for one trajectory after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: fabric_request_trajectory_evidence
tools.title: Request bounded local trajectory evidence
tools.description: Creates a signed, expiring request for selected local-vault content after explicit confirmation. The device applies its organization policy, redaction, and byte cap before disclosure.

tools.name: fabric_list_failure_atlas
tools.title: List Failure Atlas families
tools.description: Lists customer-isolated failure families, recurrence, lineage, and business consequence.

tools.name: fabric_list_remediations
tools.title: List coordinated remediation campaigns
tools.description: Lists parent campaigns and independently reversible child releases for each affected repository agent.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_stage_evaluation
tools.title: Stage one remediation evaluation candidate
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Authorizes a time-bounded evaluation candidate on one exact active local-provider endpoint belonging to the repository agent. May replace evaluation skills; does not approve a production release. Existing provenance, endpoint and release gates still apply.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_run_backtest
tools.title: Run or reconcile one remediation backtest
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. backtest must explicitly select the stored target kind. Repository proof requires exactly one candidateTrajectoryIds or matchedTrajectoryPairs list. Managed automation accepts no evidence fields and may start paid work or promote only under a previously authorized auto-update policy and existing gates. Kind mismatch rejects before execution; budgets and approval still apply.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_retry_backtest
tools.title: Retry one failed managed remediation backtest
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Retries only a failed managed held-out candidate through existing automation. May start paid work or reach promotion under a previously authorized auto-update policy. Preserves current eligibility, budget, approval and retry gates; does not reset consumed retries.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_link_backtest
tools.title: Link one completed remediation backtest
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Links one organization-owned completed campaign to the exact remediation candidate, evaluates its binding and reconciles gate state. May create or update the candidate GitHub check. Does not itself grant release approval.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_approve
tools.title: Approve one evidence-qualified remediation
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Records approval only after existing evidence and policy gates pass. If establishAutoUpdatePolicy is explicitly true, also establishes persistent policy for the organization agent across Codex, Claude, Agy and Hermes providers, rather than just one endpoint. Default false. Does not merge or release the candidate.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_merge_pr
tools.title: Merge one approved remediation pull request
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Merges the exact approved candidate pull request through the existing repository or managed lifecycle. Preserves current head, provenance, checks, GitHub-write capability and approval gates. Does not bypass a failed check or grant production promotion.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_release
tools.title: Release one approved remediation candidate
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Signs and starts the existing gated canary release, or promotes an eligible managed candidate and reconciles its signed rollout. May deploy to runtime endpoints or supersede evaluation skills. Preserves approval, provenance, rollback and production-promotion gates.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_retry_release
tools.title: Restart one rolled-back remediation canary
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Restarts only a rolled-back target with an existing signed bundle through the existing restoration, reissue and canary lifecycle. Managed targets additionally require a promoted candidate. May change runtime installations; preserves eligibility, retry, rollback and promotion gates.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_verify_release
tools.title: Verify existing signed post-release evidence
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Scores supplied, previously executed signed baseline and released trajectory pairs for one active repository release and updates proof state. Does not launch new validation tasks or prove current connectivity. Preserves exact tenant, endpoint, cohort, content and bundle bindings.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_expand
tools.title: Expand one qualified remediation rollout
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Expands the exact existing remediation rollout through its current transition gates and may deploy the signed skill to all selected managed endpoints. Preserves release, promotion, health, policy and rollback requirements; does not create unrelated authority.

tools.name: fabric_remediation_rollback
tools.title: Roll back one remediation evaluation or release
tools.description: Organization admin only, with explicit confirmation. Rolls back the exact authorized evaluation candidate or existing signed remediation rollout, including managed runtime reconciliation when applicable. May replace installed skills or runtime revisions. Preserves tenant, ancestor and transition gates; does not erase retained evidence.

tools.name: fabric_list_tasks
tools.title: List bounded Agent Fabric tasks
tools.description: Lists task state and signed envelope hashes without exposing task secrets.

tools.name: fabric_list_a2a
tools.title: List structured A2A handoffs
tools.description: Lists task-bound state-envelope handoffs; arbitrary agent chat is not exposed.

tools.name: fabric_list_skills
tools.title: List signed remediation skills
tools.description: Lists signed bundles, rollout state, and installation receipts.

tools.name: fabric_list_evals
tools.title: List continuous evaluation windows
tools.description: Lists deterministic and semantic analysis windows and their metered state.

tools.name: fabric_list_usage
tools.title: List Agent Fabric usage
tools.description: Lists organization-visible settled credits and provider usage without landed-cost fields.

tools.name: fabric_dispatch_task
tools.title: Dispatch a bounded local agent task
tools.description: Dispatches a signed task to a registered local endpoint in a relay-owned Git worktree.

tools.name: fabric_dispatch_a2a
tools.title: Dispatch a structured A2A handoff
tools.description: Hands bounded state and evidence references from an active task to another endpoint in the same workspace.

tools.name: fabric_run_analysis
tools.title: Analyze a bounded trajectory window
tools.description: Runs deterministic checks first and optional metered semantic analysis across the organization, selected logical agents, or selected endpoints.

tools.name: fabric_release_skill
tools.title: Sign an evaluated remediation skill
tools.description: Signs a deployed, held-out-passing skill revision or a signed empty baseline used only as its rollback ancestor. R3 and R4 require organization-admin approval.

tools.name: fabric_control_agent_list_sessions
tools.title: List organization control-agent sessions
tools.description: Lists the authenticated organization user’s control-agent conversations or one exact session.

tools.name: fabric_control_agent_create_session
tools.title: Create an organization control-agent session
tools.description: Creates one bounded conversation after explicit user confirmation. It does not run a model until a message is sent.

tools.name: fabric_control_agent_send_message
tools.title: Message the organization control agent
tools.description: Starts a metered managed-ADK turn and bounded organization reads: status, agents/endpoints, trajectories, failures, remediations, usage, runs and evaluations, each also exposed as a fixed fabric_control_read tool. Paid or mutating proposals are only recorded; use the individually declared execution tool and stored argument hash for each subsequent operation. This message does not approve that execution. Existing preauthorization and per-organization budgets remain.

tools.name: fabric_control_agent_list_events
tools.title: Read organization control-agent progress
tools.description: Lists ordered run, response, and approval events after a bounded cursor.
